spans.text: Delay discounting task (DDT)

description.value: A computerized delay discounting task presented choices between delayed standard monetary rewards and immediately available variable monetary rewards. The rate of delay discounting was estimated as the hyperbolic k value from six indifference points.

A computerized Go/No-Go task required participants to respond to blue Go arrows and withhold responses to green No-Go arrows. Dependent measures were commission errors, omission errors, and reaction time.

spans.text: Balloon analogue risk task (BART)

description.value: A computerized Balloon Analogue Risk Task required participants to inflate virtual balloons by mouse clicks and decide when to stop before a balloon burst. The dependent measure was the average adjusted number of pumps on unexploded balloons.
